item.text: [{"task_id":"b7fb29bc~v","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    frame = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    background = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    odd = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    even = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    inset = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    period = int(round(params['rule'][5]))","    phase = int(round(params['rule'][6]))","    out = grid.copy()","    points = np.argwhere(grid == frame)","    if len(points) == 0 or period <= 0 or inset <= 0:","        return out","    top = int(np.min(points[:, 0]))","    bottom = int(np.max(points[:, 0]))","    left = int(np.min(points[:, 1]))","    right = int(np.max(points[:, 1]))","    seeds = []","    for point in points:","        r = int(point[0])","        c = int(point[1])","        if top + inset <= r <= bottom - inset and left + inset <= c <= right - inset:","            seeds.append((r, c))","    if len(seeds) != 1:","        return out","    sr, sc = seeds[0]","    for r in range(top + inset, bottom - inset + 1):","        for c in range(left + inset, right - inset + 1):","            if grid[r, c] == background:","                distance = int(np.maximum(abs(r - sr), abs(c - sc)))","                if distance % period == phase:","                    out[r, c] = even","                else:","                    out[r, c] = odd","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[7]},"params":{"rule":[4,0,2,3,1,2,0]},"rationale":"Fill the yellow frame's interior with concentric square rings centered on its isolated yellow cell. Odd Chebyshev distances are red and even distances are green; preserve the yellow frame and seed."}]
